name: @pipeworx/mcp-us-race-matchups

tools.name: race_matchup
tools.description: One US House district or Senate seat: who the sitting officeholder is (incumbent, with seeking_reelection and incumbent_note saying whether they are actually on the ballot or the seat is open), every FEC-registered candidate by party with money raised/spent/cash on hand, which candidates won their primary, primary and general election dates. Primary vote counts come from Wikipedia (non-official, labelled as such, cites the state election authority); money and incumbency are FEC. A district that does not exist returns an error naming the districts that do.

state.description: US state: postal code ("IA") or full name ("Iowa").

district.description: House district number (1, "01") or "at-large". Required for house, ignored for senate.

special.description: Senate only: read the special-election primary page (Ohio and Florida in 2026).

tools.name: list_races
tools.description: Every federal race in a state for a cycle (the Senate seat if any, and each House district) with how many distinct people registered with the FEC and who the sitting officeholder is (incumbent; incumbent_note says when the seat is open and they are not a candidate). Use it to find the district number before calling race_matchup.

state.description: US state: postal code ("IA") or full name.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-us-race-matchups forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the us-race-matchups pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
